finding.value: An immutable port initially read every twist word from the old state, changing Python MT19937 recurrence. Local private-copy sequential replacement restores the original state transition; 72 independent original bootstrap vectors remain mandatory.

An initial harness called a nonexistent canonical_json member, classifying all cases as refusals. Corrected the harness to the actual worlds canonicalizer and exact exception class; final 45 original cases contain 5 accepted and 40 refused.

Full original unmocked T16 task training exposed update-2 loss error 0.27362306299351147. Matching source multiplication and separated forward/backward sum groups reduced the error but left approximately 9.21e-10. The source-pinned two-lane non-FMA NumPy einsum reduction repaired the complete four-fit comparison. All earlier failures remain observations; small two-row fixtures alone were insufficient.

Repaired float/int/bool and Unicode semantics, incorrect task binding, sparse arrays, accessor execution, nested mutable result aliases, and cleanup that could unlink a preexisting partial file. F1 repeated output stays strictly no-replace, including identical bytes.

The complete isolated run passed 1335 tests but its drand suite beforeAll refused absent tools/swm0w_drand/node_modules. Copied the existing pinned dependency tree with verbatim symlinks; all 9 unchanged cases passed, including source/runtime hash verification. Combined result is 1344 passed and 10 existing opt-in skipped; this is not a single green full run.

The source-compatible offline judge preserves original duplicate item-arm map overwrite and shallow envelope-projection field checks. The new assembly API rejects duplicates and requires nonblank string identities as an explicit stricter native admission boundary; it is not an exact replacement for all permissive original inputs.
